_doc: R3 §5a — the REVIEWED idle periodic timers per page (codex r3 P1-2). Only these may stay pending while a page counts as SETTLED. Key = the timer CALLBACK's source prefix (whitespace-normalized): stable across unrelated edits, and a changed callback must be re-reviewed. Each is DISPLAY-ONLY over data the page already holds — none writes or changes an order fact. Everything else blocks settling; a running callback is always awaited.
